sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check all items in this view
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

print("All non-B/G/W nodes:")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] not in ('B', 'G', 'W'):
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        print(f"  {n['color']}: pixels={n['pixels']}, center ~({center_r}, {center_c})")

# Click pink item if present
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'P':
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        print(f"Clicking P at ({center_r}, {center_c})")
        action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
